image_description: A large, white parabolic radio telescope dish situated in a forested landscape. The dish features a visible metal mesh or grid structure on its rim and support arms, with a solid white surface for the main reflector. A central feed horn assembly is suspended above the dish by struts. The base of the telescope is partially obscured by trees but shows a substantial mounting structure. A watermark text 'PHOTOGRAPHERS DIRECT.COM' is present at the bottom center.
